## (1) Overall layout (top → bottom)

The figure is a vertical flowchart with downward black arrows connecting stages. Stages, top-left to bottom:

1. **6,647 Micrographs** → (Auto pick) → **3,408,286 particles**
2. **Ab-initio reconstruction** — 3 classes (27.9% / 140,591 particles; 36.2% / 182,396; 36% / 181,384), then "40.2% / 202,743 particles" as the selected sum
3. *(omitted: 1× Hetero refinement)* → **4× Hetero refinement** — 4 classes (13.3% / 83,644; 12.1% / 76,051; 8.6% / 54,196; 66.1% / 416,605 — boxed), then 416,605 particles carried forward
4. *(omitted: 1× Non-uniform refinement)* → **Ab-initio reconstruction** (second round) — 3 classes (45% / 187,655, boxed; 44.2% / 184,116; 10.8% / 44,834), sum 45.0% / 187,655
5. *(omitted: 1× Reconstruction)* → **Non-uniform refinement** — final map, 187,655 particles

Note: the user said Chinese labels, but all visible text is in English (English/PPTX rendering, no Chinese characters appear).

## (2) Top views vs side views

- **Top views (roughly circular, flat micelle disk seen from above):** most maps look like globular/round top views — both Ab-initio #1 round-1 maps (yellow 36.2% class looks like a top view of a micelle disk; cyan 36% class as well), the yellow 12.1% and the boxed purple/blue 66.1% class in 4× Hetero refinement, and the yellow 44.2% and cyan 10.8% classes in round-2 Ab-initio. The 27.9% gray and 13.3% gray classes read as irregular/tilted rather than clean top views.
- **Side views (detergent belt around middle, protein above/below):** the cyan **8.6% class** in 4× Hetero refinement clearly shows two lobes separated — consistent with a broken/side-on micelle view (protein humps with a gap where the detergent belt should be). The final **Non-uniform refinement** map reads as a compact round top view rather than a clear side view.
- No image shows a textbook side view with a distinct horizontal detergent belt; the 8.6% class is the closest/abnormal one.

## (3) Isolated small blobs / speckle noise

- **Round-2 Ab-initio reconstruction:** all three maps (gray 45%, yellow 44.2%, cyan 10.8%) are heavily **salt-and-pepper speckle noise** — grainy low-pass textures rather than resolved density. The cyan 10.8% class especially looks like diffuse speckle with faint scattered small blobs at its edges.
- **4× Hetero refinement, 8.6% class:** shows **isolated small blobs** — a small fragment detached to the left of the main cyan density (free detergent micelle / junk particles).
- The yellow 36.2% class (round-1 ab-initio) also has a few small detached satellite blobs.

## (4) Other visual problems

- **Tiny/thin arrow text:** the "omitted: 1× Hetero refinement", "omitted: 1× Non-uniform refinement", "omitted: 1× Reconstruction" annotations are rendered in very small, light-gray type — nearly illegible at figure scale.
- **Black rectangular frames** around selected classes (36.2%, 66.1%, 45%) are fine, but they touch/crop the map edges slightly.
- **Inconsistent spacing/alignment:** the "40.2% / 202,743 particles" summary text is off-center relative to the arrow; "Ab-initio reconstruction" label of stage 3 sits to the left of the arrow rather than centered.
- **The final Non-uniform refinement map** is small relative to its importance and blurry/low-pass, with no detergent belt or features resolvable.
- **8.6% hetero-refinement class** image appears split into two pieces within one frame — poor cropping.
- Overall large empty white margins on the right and left; the flow is narrow and left-shifted.
